keyEvents.text: Goal! AEK Athens 1, Real Madrid 0. Aboubakary Koïta (AEK Athens) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Luka Jovic.
Goal! AEK Athens 1, Real Madrid 1. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Marc Cucurella with a cross.
Kervin Arriaga (AEK Athens) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Zine replaces Lovro Majer.
Delay in match because of an injury Lazaros Rota (AEK Athens).
Delay in match because of an injury Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
Substitution, AEK Athens. Razvan Marin replaces Mijat Gacinovic.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Barnabás Varga replaces Kaan Kairinen.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Marc Cucurella (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Federico Valverde replaces Yan Diomande.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Endrick replaces Bernardo Silva.
Goal! AEK Athens 2, Real Madrid 1. Stavros Pilios (AEK Athens) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Aboubakary Koïta following a fast break.
Goal! AEK Athens 2, Real Madrid 2. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Denzel Dumfries.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Brahim Díaz replaces Marc Cucurella.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Álvaro Carreras replaces Vinícius Júnior.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Carlos Espí replaces Jude Bellingham.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Oleksandr Zubkov replaces Luka Jovic.
Goal! AEK Athens 2, Real Madrid 3. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Brahim Díaz.
Aboubakary Koïta (AEK Athens) is shown the red card.
